Counts triangles (cycles of length 3) in an undirected, unweighted graph — triangle_count
text: sexp graph object, created using `new_graph` `from_*` functions method algorithm used count triangles: "brute" - edge (u, v) count many neighbors u also neighbors v, O(E * V * log(V)). "intersect" - edge (u, v) count size intersection sets neighbors, O(E * V). "online" - use online algorithm, incrementally updating every edge addition/removal.     enable_online_triangle_count(sexp, TRUE) called manually, function ,     computing triangle count using offline "intersect" algorithm - want maximum performance     first call triangle_count(sexp, "online"), call enable_online_triangle_count(sexp, TRUE)     manually beforehand. NA - uses online triangle counting enabled, "intersect" otherwise.
